info.cls_ename: Master's Program in Mechanical Engineering, Department of Mechanical and computer-Aided Engineering

description.describe_ch: 本課程旨在探討線性振動行為，課程內容包括基礎觀念、單自由度自由振動系統、簡諧振動、雙自由度振動系統、多自由度振動系統、自然頻率與模態、連續性系統振動等。
description.describe_eh: This course discusses the linear vibration behavior. The content includes foundational concepts, free vibration of single-degree-of-freedom systems, harmonically excited vibrations, two-degree-of-freedom systems, multiple-degree-of-freedom systems, natural frequencies and mode shapes, and vibrations of continuous systems.

targets.describe_ch: 學習振動力學的之基本觀念
targets.describe_en: Learning the basic concepts of mechanics of vibrations.

targets.describe_ch: 學習振動系統方程的推導
targets.describe_en: Learning the derivation of governing equations in vibration systems.

targets.describe_ch: 學習設計及分析振動系統，瞭解自然頻率、模態對系統之影響
targets.describe_en: Learning to design and analyze vibration systems, understanding the effects of natural frequencies and mode shape on the system.

targets.describe_ch: 學習建置數值模型於振動系統
targets.describe_en: Learning to construct numerical models for vibration systems.
